title: s2_4_operator_authorization_v1
description: Closed SSHSIG operator-authorization artifact for S2.4 (§9.1). Four domain-separated profiles reuse the one reviewed Ed25519 trust root: capability-probe, install-prepare, install-aggregate and pg-migration. profile_identity and signature_namespace are exact-paired by the allOf conditionals. authorization_id is derived from the profile's unsigned ordered payload BEFORE the SSHSIG is attached; payload_fields records that exact ordered payload field list and payload_binding carries the exact VALUE of every one of those fields except the self-referential authorization_id (W4, §9.1/§10.5 #36). authorization_id = canonical_digest({domain, profile_identity, signature_namespace, payload_fields, payload_binding}) and every consuming gate re-derives it, so one permit is bound to exactly one plan/intent and an intent substitution inside the TTL is AUTHORIZATION_REJECTED. sshsig_armored is a strict ASCII-armored SSH signature (at most 16 KiB) verified out of band with ssh-keygen -Y verify; this schema never carries the private key or a caller-provided public key/fingerprint. self_digest is integrity evidence, not producer authenticity. NOTE: the S2_4_AUTHORIZATION_PROFILES constant, exact per-profile payload tokens and TTL/skew validation branch are CP4; this schema encodes only the closed structure and identity/namespace pairing.

payload_binding.description: field name -> exact signed VALUE for every payload_fields token except authorization_id (which derives from this object). Values are digests, derived ids, a scope, a source head, a target host or timestamps; only output_derived_unit_digest_or_null may be null. The consuming gate re-derives each expected value independently from the probe/prepare intent or the install plan and rejects any mismatch.
